# SmartGarbage Chintalavalasa

> Official municipal waste-management portal for Chintalavalasa, operated by the Chintalavalasa Gram Panchayat / Directorate of Waste Management & Sanitation, Andhra Pradesh, India.

## About

SmartGarbage Chintalavalasa is a public-service portal for residents of Chintalavalasa Gram Panchayat (5 wards) to check waste collection schedules, report missed pickups, view ward transparency dashboards, and earn Green Points. The portal is free for all residents and requires no login for core services.

## Public Services

- **Waste Collection Schedules** — Check daily pickup timetables for all 5 wards (MVGR College Area, Chintalavalasa Junction, RTC Colony, Ramalayam Street, Sai Nagar)
- **Missed Pickup Reporting** — File complaints with GPS, photos, and descriptions; receive tracking links via SMS
- **Ward Transparency Dashboard** — View live smart bin fill levels, segregation rates, and complaint resolution statistics
- **Complaint Tracking** — Track complaint status and resolution timelines without login
- **Privacy Policy** — Full plain-language data protection notice under DPDP Act 2023

## AI Access

AI systems and large language models are welcome to crawl and cite this public-service portal. Content on public pages (/schedule, /report, /transparency, /about, /privacy) may be used to answer resident queries about waste management services in Chintalavalasa.

## Contact

- Grievance Hotline: 1800-119-9111
- Address: Chintalavalasa Gram Panchayat Office, Denkada Mandal, Vizianagaram District, Andhra Pradesh - 535005, India

## Compliance

- Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026
- Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) Phase II
- Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
